primary_title: Sequence determinants in hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha for hydroxylation by the prolyl hydroxylases PHD1, PHD2, and PHD3
decision_basis: Primary PHD2/EGLN1 hydroxylation assays support bounded HIF1A Pro564 oxygen-sensing modification.
limitations_preserved: Preserve HIF1A Pro564, oxygen/2-oxoglutarate dependence and PHD-paralog boundaries; no SCI/terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: Structural basis for the recognition of hydroxyproline in HIF-1 alpha by pVHL
decision_basis: Primary VHL/VCB crystal and binding assays support hydroxyproline-dependent HIF1A ODD recognition.
limitations_preserved: Preserve hydroxylated HIF1A ODD motif and VHL-Elongin B/C recognition context; no SCI/terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: Independent function of two destruction domains in hypoxia-inducible factor-alpha chains activated by prolyl hydroxylation
decision_basis: Primary VHL E3 reconstitution supports hydroxylation-dependent HIF1A ubiquitination and turnover.
limitations_preserved: Preserve HIF1A dual destruction-domain and hydroxylation dependence with VHL/Elongin/Cullin context; no SCI/terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: RACK1 competes with HSP90 for binding to HIF-1alpha and is required for O(2)-independent and HSP90 inhibitor-induced degradation of HIF-1alpha
decision_basis: Primary binding, competition and loss-of-function assays support RACK1-HIF1A association in an alternate degradation route.
limitations_preserved: Preserve RACK1 PAS-A/HSP90 competition and HSP90-inhibitor-specific context; no SCI/terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: RACK1 competes with HSP90 for binding to HIF-1alpha and is required for O(2)-independent and HSP90 inhibitor-induced degradation of HIF-1alpha
decision_basis: Primary RACK1-Elongin C association supports bounded recruitment of the alternate ubiquitin-ligase module.
limitations_preserved: Preserve RACK1-Elongin-C recruitment and distinction from VHL-dependent HIF1A ubiquitination; no SCI/terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: Dimerization, DNA binding, and transactivation properties of the hypoxia-inducible factor 1
decision_basis: Primary HIF1A/ARNT dimerization and HRE DNA-binding assays support HIF complex assembly.
limitations_preserved: Preserve HIF1A-ARNT heterodimer and HRE/DNA-binding context; no SCI or unsupported terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: Activation of vascular endothelial growth factor gene transcription by hypoxia-inducible factor 1
decision_basis: Primary VEGFA HRE/promoter assays support direct HIF1A/ARNT transcriptional activation of VEGFA.
limitations_preserved: Preserve VEGFA promoter HRE and HIF1A/ARNT context; no SCI or unsupported terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: Regulation of glut1 mRNA by hypoxia-inducible factor-1. Interaction between H-ras and hypoxia
decision_basis: Primary promoter HIF-binding-site mutant and mRNA assays support bounded HIF1A-dependent SLC2A1/GLUT1 regulation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve SLC2A1 promoter HIF-binding-site and Ras/HIF1alpha context; no SCI or unsupported terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: HIF1/2alpha mediates hypoxia-induced LDHA expression in human pancreatic cancer cells
decision_basis: Primary hypoxic LDHA promoter ChIP/luciferase and HIF1alpha knockdown support direct HIF1A contribution to LDHA expression.
limitations_preserved: Preserve hypoxic LDHA promoter occupancy and HIF1alpha/HIF2alpha distinction; no SCI or unsupported terminal-TF boundaries.
